title: Antarctica in 15 seconds
subject: evolution
native_material: measurements of cold, ice and sea level; places
metaphors: the sea rising up a London landmark

concept.logline: The coldest place on Earth, and the water locked in its ice.
concept.central_question: How much ice is down there?
concept.claim: Antarctica's ice is so thick that melting it would raise the seas 58 metres.

scenes.narration: The coldest place ever measured? Here. Minus 89.2 degrees.
scenes.graphic: Globe: Antarctica + Vostok Station | Coldest ever: −89.2 °C · Vostok, 1983

scenes.narration: Its ice is almost five kilometres thick. Here's the Burj Khalifa beside it.

scenes.narration: Melt it all, and the seas rise 58 metres. Most of Big Ben's tower, gone.
